title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
abstract: arXiv:2608.29464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. translated_title: 推理模型思维链的忠实性随偏好线索的传递位置与方式而变化
translated_abstract: 思维链监测的前提假设是推理过程忠实地记录了影响模型回答的信息。现有的忠实性测试通常将显式的偏见线索置于用户消息中，而智能体在实际运行中可能通过工具返回结果或原始数据工件接触到偏好信息。我们提出了FACE-Eval（线索效应忠实归因评估），这是一个包含5,100个样本的评估基准，通过改变线索的位置（用户消息或工具返回结果）和显式程度（直接总结或原始数据工件）来系统考察这一问题。我们测量了遵循线索的回答中的言语化承诺，以及所有含线索样本中的未言语化采纳。我们评估了来自八个模型家族的15个开源权重模型，总参数量从4B到1.60T不等。结果显示：所有模型对工具返回线索的言语化承诺均低于用户消息线索，对隐式线索的言语化承诺均低于显式线索；此外，在全部15个模型上，工具返回线索导致的未言语化采纳率更高，在30个模型-通道对比中的28个里，隐式线索的未言语化采纳率也更高。
tldr: 论文提出FACE-Eval评估基准，揭示推理模型的思维链忠实性取决于偏好线索的传递位置和显式程度——相比用户消息和显式线索，通过工具返回和隐式方式传递的偏好更容易被模型默默采纳而不在思维链中如实言明。
en_tdlr: FACE-Eval reveals that reasoning models' chain-of-thought faithfulness depends on where and how preference cues are delivered—tool-return and implicit cues lead to significantly higher unverbalized adoption of preferences compared to user-message and explicit cues.
